Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.27 - BLU Autorotation ALPHA: full damage kit + DoT fixes
- Now casts the entire damaging spellbook you have slotted (single-target AND AoE), not a subset - no more idling when a few spells are on cooldown.
- Fixed DoTs re-applying while already up (Mortal Flame is permanent -> special handling; per-target cast tracking as backstop).
- Mortal Flame now correctly gets Bristle (it is magic damage); the permanent snapshot makes it a top Bristle target.
- Removed Winged Reprobation (stack combo) and channels (Flame Thrower/Phantom Flurry/Apokalypsis) from greedy auto - they need dedicated handling. Still ALPHA, single-target priority, BLU-only.

v1.0.4.26 - BLU Autorotation ALPHA fixes
- Fixed Mortal Flame / DoT double-casting (JustUsed guard).
- Fixed the engine stalling and leaving much of the kit uncast: expanded the catalog to the full verified level-80 single-target kit, gated melee spells on range, Sonic Boom as guaranteed filler.
- Corrected the combo anchor to Sonic Boom. Still ALPHA, single-target only, BLU-only.

v1.0.4.25 - Blue Mage Single-Target Autorotation (ALPHA)
- New BLU_ST_AdvancedMode: a damage-per-cast-time priority engine that auto-casts whatever BLU spells you have slotted, in the highest-DPS order. Weaves oGCDs, keeps DoTs up without clipping, dumps Surpanakha together, and only uses Bristle/Whistle/Tingle when it is worth the GCD. Greedy; no Moon Flute burst window yet. ALPHA - experimental, BLU only, other jobs unaffected.

v1.0.4.23 - Silence & Pacification Handling
- Pacification (status 6): autorotation skips oGCD abilities, falls through to GCD weaponskills.
- Silence (status 7): autorotation tries Echo Drops (item 4566) when off cooldown, then skips spells if not available.
- Earlier May 27 work: DismountOnAbility toggle (default ON) auto-dismounts when an ability is pressed while mounted.

v1.0.4.22 - Dynamic BossMod Distance Adjustments
- Automatically sets BossMod / BossModReborn AI target distance on job change (3 for melee/tanks, 15 for healers, 20 for ranged/magical DPS).

v1.0.4.21 - Upstream Queueing Fix
- Integrated WrathCombo 1.0.4.7's improved recast queueing detour for reliable action queuing.

v1.0.4.20 - Dark Knight (DRK) TBN Enhancements
- Added EnemiesTargetingPlayerCount() utility helper to track aggressive hostiles targeting the player.
- Updated DRK non-boss mitigation to automatically cast The Blackest Night (TBN) when an incoming tankbuster is detected (via HasIncomingTankBusterEffect()).
- Updated DRK non-boss and boss mitigation to automatically cast TBN on cooldown during trash pulls (when 3 or more enemies target the player), bypassing standard health threshold gates for maximum active mitigation.
